frames.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate exactly ONE animation frame, idle_0, of an original female KNIGHT pixel-art game sprite. Transparent background. No helmet. One straight silver arming sword with gold crossguard in her near hand, held down-right; far hand a small closed gauntlet. Stable relaxed combat stance, boots on same baseline. Figure body roughly 30px wide and 48px tall; sword may extend to right, no shield. Render as a nearest-neighbor 8x enlarged pixel sprite in a spacious transparent 1024x960 canvas corresponding to logical 128x120; logical feet anchor (64,112), logical head top y64. No text, no floor, no shadow, no contact sheet. Match the attached Cookie's large face, small torso and chunky pixel scale, but completely original knight outfit and hair silhouette.
